product_metadata.title: Silicone Drink Coasters Set of 6 , IPHOX 3.94 inches Flexible Heat Resistant Coaster for Drinks with Deep Grooved and Non-Slip Bottom, Protect Furniture from Dirty and Scratched (Black)

CONVENIENT USE and CLEAN: This set of 6 cup coaster with a suitable holder, convenient to use and collect. The table coasters are dishwasher-safe, Or it can be wiped down or hand washed. Premium dining/drinking accessories with a classy look.

PERFECT DESIGN: Deep Grooved Patterns and ribbed Pattern design, ensures your glass, mug, or cup stays in place and helps prevent spills. Leisurely sip your drink and avoid the headache of spills, wine stains, broken glassware or unsightly water ring stains on your tabletops.

LIMITED LIFETIME SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: If your absorbent coaster becomes worn or damaged, we'll send you a new one at no cost within 30-day money-back guarantee period. Perfect gift idea for Christmas, New Year, Housewarming, Birthday, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day.
